# .NET 10 Upgrade Progress

## Overview

Upgrading the ExpTreeLib solution from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0 using an All-At-Once strategy. All 3 projects will be updated simultaneously, with a focus on Windows Forms modernization and API compatibility fixes.

**Progress**: 7/7 tasks complete (100%) ![100%](https://progress-bar.xyz/100)

## Tasks

- ✅ 01-framework-and-sdk-setup: Verify .NET 10 SDK and prepare environment
- ✅ 02-update-target-frameworks: Update all project files to net10.0
- ✅ 03-fix-windows-forms-compatibility: Address Windows Forms API incompatibilities
- ✅ 04-resolve-system-api-compatibility: Fix remaining API incompatibilities
- ✅ 05-compile-and-verify-build: Restore dependencies and verify full build
- ✅ 06-run-unit-tests: Execute all unit tests
- ✅ 07-integration-validation: Smoke test the WinForms application
